thread:
emma.sales: Customer POC failing with 413 / "payload too large" when they include full session + screenshots. They say assistant "drops earlier instructions" after retries.

raj.engineer: Gateway log shows `status=413 content_length=3890210`. They bundle last 50 messages and 3 screenshots inline base64.

nina-sre: Hosted gateway default body_limit=2MB. Runtime also has sequence cap (default 16384 tokens) and will reject larger sequences with a 400. So two failure modes.

emma.sales: Customer asked if we can simply bump limits for the POC and what it costs.

carlos-ps: Short options to propose to customer: (1) Stop inline images: upload to S3/presigned URL and send URLs. (2) Enable gzip: set `Content-Encoding: gzip`, often reduces text-heavy payloads under 2MB. (3) Client-side summarization of older turns or set `truncate: \"tail\"` and `max_input_tokens` in SDK.

raj.engineer: If they need raw history unmodified, ops can request a temporary gateway bump to 6-8MB for their org, but requires NDA addendum + ticket. Also need billing sign-off for higher worst-case token usage.

nina-sre: ops-bot: ticket created?

ops-bot: ticket #1234 opened for gateway limit increase (org_X1), status: awaiting-approval :rotating_light:

carlos-ps: For pricing: explain that increasing context increases per-request tokens. Provide an estimated worst-case: max_tokens_per_call * expected_calls * token_price. Sales should ask customer for calls/month to compute.

emma.sales: I'll ask for usage numbers and whether they can host images externally. Can someone draft a short email with config examples?

carlos-ps: Quick copy:
- Immediate: switch images to URLs, set `Content-Encoding: gzip`.
- SDK: set `truncate: \"tail\"` and `max_input_tokens: 8192` to avoid runtime rejections.
- Mid-term: run nightly/inline summarization to compress older turns.
- Escalation: ops ticket #1234 requests temporary gateway bump; requires NDA + billing approval.

raj.engineer: I'll also add a note to recommend enabling KV-cache and strict per-request token guards if we lift the gateway limit.

emma.sales: Thanks all. I'll send to the customer and request their calls/month so we can model pricing impact. Meeting requested for tomorrow.
